summary: Fly-E Group, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, reporting that Nasdaq Staff closed a delinquency matter after the company filed its Form 10-K for the period ended March 31, 2026, on July 23, 2026. The company had received a delinquency notification letter on July 21, 2026, regarding non-compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). With the late filing remedied, Nasdaq determined compliance, and the matter is closed. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms, strategic actions, or extraordinary events are described. What to watch: continued timely filings to avoid future delisting risk.
